rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality early blastocyst/transitioning morula-blastocyst with absent/degenerate ICM and disorganized TE, consistent with 0DD. Minor overinterpretation of granular material and limited comment on zona pellucida.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, endometriosis, ovarian response, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Overall logic is clear, but the probability section contains internal inconsistency: implantation is estimated at 18–30%, yet later clinical pregnancy is stated as only 6–10%, which is not coherent.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and evidence-based IVF practice, including caution about add-ons and selective use of PGT-A. Some speculative suggestions around endometriosis surgery/optimization are less tightly guideline-driven without more context.

Provides practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, luteal support, follow-up testing, and future evaluation steps. Useful and nuanced, though some future-planning suggestions are somewhat broad rather than tightly prioritized.
